name: Tim Beiko
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: The Twitter account of Tim Beiko, the core developer of Ethereum, was suspected of being stolen. He posted two tweets about "ETH airdrop" within half an hour with a phishing link(ether.fo). Users are asked not to click on suspicious links to prevent funds from being stolen. According to the analysis of SlowMist, the mastermind behind the scenes is PinkDrainer.
